title: Abdul Hameed Alias Abdul Haneef v. U.P. Power Corporation Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Laxmi Kanta Mohapatra, J.; Sunita Agarwal, J.
disposition: Check meter directed under clause 5.6; bills to be corrected on result
headnote: On a domestic consumer's plea that the licensee had neither installed a check meter nor revised a disputed high-consumption bill, the Court directed installation of a check meter under clause 5.6 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005 within one month, and correction of bills according to the inspection result.
facts: The petitioner held a domestic connection from U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. and had been paying charges. In July and August 2011 the licensee raised a bill of Rs.1,50,773. Objecting, he deposited Rs.50,000 and asked for a check meter to test whether the existing meter was defective. His grievance was that neither a check meter had been installed nor the July 2011 bill revised. He sought a writ for check-meter installation and bill correction.

holding_units.topic: check meter for alleged defective meter
holding_units.holding: Where a domestic consumer disputes a high-consumption bill and seeks a check meter alleging the installed meter is defective, the licensee must install a check meter in terms of clause 5.6 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 and, depending on the inspection result, pass appropriate orders for correction of bills.
